name: WHAT HATH GOD WROUGHT
source:
With the dawn of the 21st century came the Great Crash — a worldwide data catastrophe that wiped entire cities off the map, and swallowed the Internet whole. Three years later, the Chicago post-Crash zone is a carefully monitored wasteland, patrolled by those who seek to contain it. 

Rachel is a data scientist, running experiments for her thesis. Lori is a fixer, just trying to make ends meet.

This is the story of their failure.

[From [url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/what-hath-god-wrought]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
随着21世纪的到来，大崩溃来临了——一场全球性的数据灾难，将整个城市从地图上抹去，并吞没了整个互联网。三年后，芝加哥的事故后区域变成了一片受到严密监控的荒地，由那些试图控制它的人巡逻。

雷切尔是一名数据科学家，正在为她的论文进行实验。洛瑞是一个调解者，只是想维持收支平衡。

这就是他们失败的故事。

[来自[url=https://fisheranimal.itch.io/what-hath-god-wrought]itch.io[/url]]
